responsibility: This file implements functionality shared by the C and Objective-C front ends, especially diagnostics and common lang-hook helpers. It provides shared initialization, warning policy helpers such as unused-global and missing-noreturn decisions, C-family diagnostic pretty-printing of declarations, expressions, types, and qualifiers (including “aka” typedef-expansion printing), linkage and type-compatibility hooks, VLA/backend queries, and alias-set handling for C-family types.
same_name_distinction: This .c file is the executable implementation for the shared C/Objective-C layer, defining the common initialization, diagnostics printers, type/linkage predicates, and alias/VLA helpers; gcc/c/c-objc-common.h is the companion hook-configuration header that mainly maps LANG_HOOKS macros to these shared routines.
